Name: Auto Stacker
Author: CatCattyCat
Description:
[size=6]Item Auto Stacker

[/size]Press the activation key (by default k, can be changed by editing config.json), and all the items in your inventory will be stacked together into as few stacks as possible. [u]It won't stack unstackable items or stack things over the maximum stack limit.[/u]

Requires[url=https://smapi.io] SMAPI v2.9.0+[/url].

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files][size=5]Check out my other mods by clicking here![/size][/url]

Downloads.Description: Place in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder to install. Requires SMAPI v3.0+.

Manifest.Name: Auto Stacker
Manifest.Description: Press a key (K by default) to automatically stack the current items in the open inventory.
Manifest.Author: Cat
